name: Jethro
summary: The priest of Midian who took Moses into his home and gave him his daughter Zipporah as a wife. Later he praised the LORD for rescuing Israel and taught Moses to share the work of judging.

key_moments.title: Takes Moses into His Home
key_moments.description: After Moses helped Reuel's seven daughters water their flock, Reuel invited him to eat. Moses agreed to live with him and married his daughter Zipporah.

key_moments.title: Lets Moses Return to Egypt
key_moments.description: Moses asked Jethro to let him return to his people in Egypt, and Jethro sent him off in peace.

key_moments.title: Rejoicing at the Good News
key_moments.description: Jethro brought Moses his wife and sons in the wilderness. Hearing all the LORD had done for Israel, he rejoiced, declared the LORD greater than every other god, and offered sacrifices.

key_moments.title: Advises Moses to Share the Judging
key_moments.description: Seeing Moses judge the people alone from morning to evening, Jethro told him the load was too heavy. He advised him to choose able, honest men to judge the small matters, and Moses did so.
